newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 13.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 13.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- One million workplaces were abolished in the country since the 80s, according to the latest survey.
- Hungarian airlines Malev cancelled its flight to Tirana because the Tirana airport had been closed.
- The government plans to spend one and a half billion forints to compensate energy retail price increases.
- Hungarian farmers demonstrate in 67 roads of the country but several counties said that demonstrations will be finished by early afternoon.
- Almost 50,000 cartons of cigarettes were seized in a refrigerated lorry at Roszke. This was the second similar case within one day.
- Austria does not plan to review its neutrality policy for the time being even if the eastward expansion of NATO gets on the agenda, said the Austrian chancellor who prepares for a visit in Hungary.
